versions.title: Faster spawning

groups.name: New
items: After you spawn a hero, the next one from your reserve is picked for you: another copy of the same hero if you have one, otherwise the next hero in line

commits: Spawning: after a spawn, the next reserve hero is picked for you

versions.title: Rock paper scissors and clearer spells

groups.name: New
items: Rock paper scissors decides who goes first in online and Pass & play games: best of 3. With 3-4 players everyone throws at once, points reset after each place is decided, and AI seats throw too. The winner moves first (and in Pass & play also bans and picks first). Turn it off in Match options
When anyone casts a spell you can see, a callout tells you who cast what on whom and what it does, with the real numbers
Every status now shows on the board: Aegis shields, cages, Runeforged Edge, tethers, Ossify, Mimic shapes, charms, standing in flames, and a warning when you stand in a Noon Verdict ring

groups.name: Balance
items: Nightstalker (Assassin) now has Charge: it moves and attacks in the same turn. Damage 8 → 6, and it costs 4 gold
The AI no longer wastes turns and mana on walls, snares, flares and silences it does not need, so AI Stonewrights, Trappers and scouts play much better

groups.name: Visuals
items: Status badges are bigger and filled with their colour
Tap a hero to see each of its statuses: what it does and how long it lasts
A coloured chip pops up over a hero when it gains or loses a status

commits: AI: skip abilities it scores as not worth it
Assassin gets Charge; AI no longer builds the walls it meant to skip
Rock paper scissors: points reset for each place, AI seats throw too
Rock paper scissors for who goes first (online and Pass & play)
Spells and statuses read clearly in battle

versions.title: Fixes

groups.name: Fixes
items: Phone: the ban confirm bar now goes away after you confirm a ban

commits: Ban phase on phone: the ban confirm bar now closes after a ban is confirmed

versions.title: Spellcasters, a tutorial and a big balance pass

groups.name: New
items: 21 new spellcasters, 3 for every faction, with spell cooldowns
Lancer, Raiders, Hellhound, Wolf Pack, Death Knight and Alpha Direwolf can now Charge: move and attack in the same turn
Ambush: walking into a hidden enemy (in fog or a forest) stops your hero with a big "!", and only that hero's turn ends
Tutorial: learn to move, attack, spawn, use gold and abilities and hit towers in 8 short steps (main menu > Tutorial)
Searchable Help (press ? or H): rules, every hero, keywords and statuses, with links between them
First-time tips, which you can turn off or reset in Display
Browse lobbies: see open rooms with their host, players, mode and map, and join with an optional room password
Leave an online lobby from Main menu
What's new screen: see what changed after each update

groups.name: Balance
items: Hero prices reworked from thousands of test games. Cheap heroes that were too strong now cost 5 gold, Tanks no longer pay +2 gold, and builders, control and support heroes are cheaper
Arcane Order is stronger: 1-mana attacks are free, Arcane synergy gives +2 mana a turn, and 7 Arcane heroes have more HP
Four rounds of boss balance: the strongest bosses (including the Charge bosses) are weaker and the weakest are stronger
Fog of war: every unit sees 1 hex less
Sudden death starts at round 56 on larger maps (still round 14 on Classic)

groups.name: Fixes
items: Many fixes from playtesting: market pictures, ability targeting, the AI pushes towers, one copy per boss, turn log, bans
Fixed several boss bugs
The old main menu no longer flashes while the game loads

groups.name: Visuals
items: Animation pass: weapon attacks with hit reactions, idle breathing, knockouts, spell wind-ups, fliers glide
Lighter, faster-loading hero art
Clearer battle screen: Day/Night chip, whose turn it is, status badges, tower HP and objectives
Phone: nothing pops up over the board any more, and the battle screen is much less cluttered
Hero selection highlights what each hero is used for

commits: Gold cost balance: reprice heroes from AI-vs-AI win-rate sims
Main menu: stop the old menu flashing while the page loads
Boss balance pass 4 (sim-tested): Marshal, Plague Lord, Thunder King, Forge Master
Boss balance pass 3 (sim-tested): trim the Charge bosses, lift the Arcane Order
Hero selection: highlight each card's "Use" line
Boss balance pass 2 (sim-tested): buff the bottom bosses, trim High Seraph
Lobby browser: Browse lobbies list (name, host, players n/cap, mode, map, Full / In battle), optional room passwords checked on the server, host room name & password editor
Tutorial, searchable Help, first-time tips, and leaving an online lobby
Boss balance pass + boss bug fixes (sim-tested)
Phone battle screen: nothing pops up over the board, and far less clutter
Readable in-game UI: Day/Night chip, meters, whose turn, status badges, tower HP + objectives, crisp spent heroes
Add Charge to Lancer, Raiders, Hellhound, Wolf Pack, Death Knight and Alpha Direwolf; price Charge in hireCost
21 new spellcasters (3 per faction) with spell cooldowns and spell-priced hiring; AI casts Rewind, Bone Shrapnel, Sweet Command and Iron Cage when they help; Tilted view support

Animation pass: weapon-type attacks with hit reactions (flinch, knockback, white flash, big-hit shake), varied idle breathing and body-type K.O. animations, element-tinted spell wind-ups and impacts, UI motion (turn chip, card deal, panel fades, gold/mana tick-up), flier glide and tank footstep sounds
Marlowe playtest fixes: market thumbnails, ability targets + Q, AI pushes towers, one copy per boss, turn log, ban confirm + AI bans, readable hexes, Display speed/volume, Hex Rose screens, 1v1 rooms
Lighter hero art: pre-rendered webp portraits (scene + figure) and board figures, and a draft pick rebuilds only the changed card
Ambush alert: big "!" over a unit stopped by a hidden enemy
Sudden death: round 56 on larger maps (14 on Classic)
Fog of war: all units see 1 hex less (min 1)
What's new screen: update notes from public/changelog.json once per new version, with a Hex Rose menu pill

versions.title: Faction powers, a tilted board and a new main menu

groups.name: New
items: Each faction now has its own powers: Wilds hide in forests, Infernal set the ground on fire, Undead leave Graves, Vampires grow stronger at night
Necromancer's Raise the Slain: when he kills an enemy hero, an Undead hero of the same cost rises on your side
Warlock can turn into a bat and fly before moving
Towers strike back at melee attackers, and other buildings and walls hit back too. Ranged attacks are safe
Tilted view lays the board back like a diorama. Turn it on in Display, with V on PC or from the phone zoom bar
New Hex Rose main menu. Living Map and Hall of Heroes styles are in Display

groups.name: Balance
items: Counterattacks get weaker as the defender loses HP
Nightstalker is a true glass cannon: 4 HP and 8 damage (was 7 HP and 10 damage)
Rogue 9 → 8 HP and Wraith 7 → 6 HP
War Engine damage 2 → 4
Arcane Flow also lowers Hexweaver's Silence cost from 2 to 1 mana
Countess and Warlock attacks cost 1 mana. Undying now brings Undead back with 2 HP (was 3)

groups.name: Fixes
items: Hero cards and tooltips now match the real stats (splash, cleave, ranges, heal pokes and hire prices)
Raise the Slain and Graves now work separately, so a raise never uses up a Grave

groups.name: Visuals
items: HP bars show one notch per HP point, so you can count health at a glance
Heroes walk their path hex by hex, and fliers glide

commits: Assassins: Nightstalker becomes a true glass cannon (7 HP/10 dmg -> 4 HP/8 dmg); Rogue 9->8 HP, Wraith 7->6 HP

Raise the Slain no longer uses Graves: raises and Graves are independent (a raise never needs, uses, moves or removes a Grave; Graves never change where a raise lands). Drops the RZHOOK grave hook and hvGraveTake; tooltip, How to Play and README text updated
View: Classic / Tilted 2.5D board (client-only, default Classic)
Arcane Flow also lowers Hexweaver's Silence cost (2 -> 1): eff() carries slcost; cast, target check, AI, button, card keyword, How to Play and README use it

Faction mechanics: Wilds Hidden Paths/Overgrowth/Pack Bond, Infernal Scorched Earth + Heat, Undead Graves + Vengeful Dead, Vampire Night Falls, forest trackers; Warlock Bat Form and 1-mana Countess/Warlock attacks
HP bars: one notch per HP point on units, heroes, bosses, towers, buildings and walls
Counters scale with HP, structures strike back, heroes walk their path
Unit text: match live stats (half-damage splash and melee cleave, Arcane Flow mana for Stormcaller/Starweaver, ranges, heal pokes, boss roles, squads list, hire prices, README slots)
Necromancer: revert damage to 3 (keeps Raise the Slain)
Necromancer: +1 damage (3 -> 4) and Raise the Slain
War Engine: +2 damage (2 -> 4)
Main menu redesign: Hex Rose menu by default, with Living Map and Hall of Heroes styles in Display settings

versions.title: Painted tiles and water

groups.name: New
items: Big maps now have deep and shallow water with beaches and docks. Walk through shallows; only fliers cross deep water

groups.name: Visuals
items: Every map is painted with new hex tiles, shorelines and fog

commits: Painted hex tiles and water: holes on big maps become deep and shallow water with mirrored beaches and docks

versions.title: Spawn animations

groups.name: Visuals
items: Units now arrive with a spawn animation in their faction's style, with a variation for each unit
Hero portraits are framed around the whole figure, so no more cut-off heads

commits: Spawn animations: one style per faction with per-unit variants
Hero select: frame painted portraits by their real figure bounds

versions.title: Smoother online games

groups.name: Balance
items: Wounded heroes hit softer: their damage drops toward half as they lose HP

groups.name: Fixes
items: A page opened before an update can no longer join a game running the newer version (this is what made a friend load the wrong map)
Out-of-date pages now reload by themselves and put you back in your seat

groups.name: Visuals
items: Undead with Undying collapse into a bone pile and rise again

commits: Update from Renegade Dev Console

Online: build check so pages loaded before a deploy can't join newer games (fixes friend loading Classic while host is on another map); stale pages auto-reload into their seat, pre-check pages are refused; unknown map in game start forces a reload

versions.title: Cottages, Great Halls and steadier towers

groups.name: New
items: Build a Cottage (+2 army slots, up to 3) or a Great Hall (+5 slots) to grow your army up to 31

groups.name: Balance
items: Your base army cap is now 20
Towers no longer lose HP every round before sudden death

commits: Army cap 20 with Cottage/Great Hall, no tower decay before sudden death

versions.title: Big maps and PC fullscreen

groups.name: New
items: Map picker: Classic, 5 hand-made big maps, or a mirrored random map in one of 6 shapes
Big maps have extra shrines, mines and chests to fight over
Drag to pan and zoom the camera on every map
PC fullscreen: the board fills the screen with a floating HUD. Press F to toggle it
Edge scrolling, arrow keys and Ctrl + mouse wheel zoom on PC
The draft now has 10 team slots: heroes take 1 to 4 slots by price, bosses take 5

groups.name: Balance
items: Splash hits deal half damage, and melee splash is now a 3-hex cleave in front of the attacker
Lancer's reach is now a 2-hex pierce
Tanks get +50% HP and -25% damage and cost 2 more gold. Bosses get +40% HP
Freeze, stun, splash, silence, long range and drain now cost more to hire (Frost Witch 3 → 7 gold)

groups.name: Visuals
items: Lancer has a new thrust animation
Bigger board tiles, so every painted hero fits inside its hex

commits: PC fullscreen: menus use the whole window; in-game board fills the screen with floating HUD; edge scrolling, arrow keys, drag and Ctrl+wheel zoom on every map; Fullscreen button (F) that turns on when a match starts
Combat: splash deals half damage; melee splash is a 3-hex frontal cleave; Lancer reach becomes a 2-tile pierce with thrust animation
Wider health gap: tanks +50% HP, -25% damage, +2 gold; bosses +40% HP
Hire/recruit: army limit counts team slots (10); multiple bosses allowed when there are 5 free slots; clear 'not enough slots' messages
Draft: 10 team slots; heroes take 1-4 slots by gold price, bosses take 5; army cap raised to 10; slot badges on hero cards
Hire prices: add gold premiums for freeze/stun, splash, silence, long range and drain (Frost Witch 3 -> 7); bosses unchanged

Map overhaul: map picker with Classic, 5 pre-built big maps and mirrored random maps (4x tiles, 6 shapes); extra shrines/mines/chests on big maps; drag-to-pan and zoom camera; online map choice synced by the host
